input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic remote monitoring center reported a minor, non-recurrent ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity with no adverse patient outcome recorded. The retrospective clinician note documenting this ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity was never filed, so recurrence cannot yet be ruled out from the record alone. The case is being handled at a monitoring/investigation level, not as a confirmed life-threatening event.

risk_report.rationale: A minor, non-recurrent ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity was detected by the remote monitoring center, but a clinician note documenting it was not filed. While no adverse patient outcome occurred and the event is being handled at a monitoring/investigation level, the lack of a documented record raises concerns about potential recurrence or missed detection in the future. This requires investigation to determine why the clinician note was missing and whether any systemic issues contributed to this gap in documentation. The device incorporates software (EU MDR Annex I, Section 17.1) and is automated with computer software (21 CFR § 820.10(c)), necessitating adherence to design controls and a robust software development lifecycle (EU MDR Annex I, Section 17.2).  The incident may trigger obligations under EU MDR Annex I, Section 17.2 regarding the software development lifecycle and cybersecurity.
